title: When git commit skips your brand new file #shorts #git
description:
git commit -am only stages files Git already tracks, so a brand new file is skipped. Check with git status -s, git add the new file, then commit.

Full episode: "git status, add & commit Explained Simply | Git & GitHub Ep 4" on the Tech-dev channel.
New episodes Mon, Wed & Fri, 4 PM IST.
